title: A Unified Theory of Edge Weights: Stability of General Laplacian Networks from Matrix Phases and Asymmetry Rayleigh Ratios
summary: We study the properties and stability of networks with arbitrary Laplacian coupling. Classic approaches to studying networked systems require unrealistic assumptions, including homogeneous node dynamics, one-dimensional and undirected edges, or constant edge weights. We develop a unified formulation of Laplacian-style couplings that drops these assumptions, providing a unified notion for the edge weights of adaptive, directed, and multi-dimensional edges.
